column1: # DISCLOSED NON-APPEND-ONLY REFLOG ENTRIES — the only ones v1/tools/p0-append-only-check.sh excuses.
# The append-only rule (v1/P0-EVIDENCE-FORMAT.md section 5) binds every BUILD and FIX
# session of this contract: a fix lands as a NEW COMMIT. No amend, no rebase, no reset.
# The check reads the branch reflog and fails on any entry that moved the branch other
# than by fast-forward, or whose operation is an amend, a rebase or a reset.
# One such entry already existed when the rule was written, and it is disclosed here
# rather than hidden or erased. Erasing it would be a second history rewrite; leaving it
# undisclosed would make the check fail forever and teach the next session to delete the
# check. So the check excuses EXACTLY the triples listed below and nothing else — and
# because this file is tracked, adding a line to it is a visible diff a reviewer reads.
# `operation` is the reflog message's operation word. `disclosure` names the document
# that explains the entry in full. `branch` scopes the excuse: a disclosure written for
# A disclosed entry must ALSO still be reachable: the check runs `git cat-file -e` on
# old_sha and fails if the pre-rewrite commit was actually destroyed. Disclosure is not
# a licence to lose an object.
